author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
Well, if most of your gear is pushing towards caster, you won't  regret buying a Celestial Staff. The benefit is that when adorned properly, and running sequencer, you can *guarantee* all of your 2-turn spells, like Ultima, only take one turn. This is one of the more reliable early raiding builds and you'll use the staff forever.

Otherwise, since you don't have Ultima yet, consider a celestial class to help add some spice. Like the other person said, Deity Ara is awfully fun and is caster oriented. It's much less complex than Heretic is and is one of the best Endless dungeon classes. Endless is going to be mandatory as you move into the real endgame. You can wear any gear as Deity, so you get to be tankier much more easily while still having high magic and using your caster weapons.
